public_declarations.complete_header:
theorem n04Coordinates_unitAtom_absolute_iteratedFDeriv_envelope
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hfloor : ∀ m, 1 ≤ T.E0 (T.sample (K.cell m)))
    (href : CanonicalGeometry.ReferenceJets D T S C L K)
    (hcur : CanonicalGeometry.CurrentJets D T S C L K base ε) :
    ∃ loss : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ A B : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧
      ∀ z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε, ∀ m v p,
        p ∈ CanonicalGeometry.unitStrip → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
            (CanonicalGeometry.atom D T S C L K (liftSectorParameter S C z) m v) p‖ ≤
            (2 : ℝ) ^ N * A * T.E0 (T.sample (K.cell m)) ^ B *
              (1 + CanonicalGeometry.parameterGrading S (N + loss) z)

actual_smoothness_provider.type: ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (CanonicalGeometry.atom D T S C L K (liftSectorParameter S C z) m v) CanonicalGeometry.unitStrip

self_review: The existing CurrentJets first conjunct supplies smoothness for the literal current unit atom on the literal unitStrip. No independent smoothness or final norm bound is introduced as a premise.
The supplier n04Coordinates_unitAtom_absolute_envelope is called once. Its loss is retained before N, and its A and B are chosen once at N before every state, piece, atom, point and k≤N.

The compiled cylinder lemma applies at the same point and same open strip. For each i+j=k, equality followed by k≤N gives the original supplier's order bound. Real.norm_eq_abs is the only scalar norm conversion.

The product M is nonnegative by A>0, the original sampled E0 floor and nonnegativity of the parameter seminorm. Only 2^k is enlarged to 2^N; neither the material exponent B nor parameter order N+loss changes.
Order zero is included by the existing cylinder theorem, without a separate selected witness.
The exact original K, D/T/S/C/L, liftSectorParameter, sample T.sample(K.cell m), domain, and loss are preserved.
limitations: Static self-review; root independent peer and future CI required.
This converts actual ReferenceJets plus CurrentJets into spatial Frechet norm bounds. It does not construct CurrentJets or finish CanonicalPrimitiveGeometry.
